_what: Template, not an approval. Copy to .crm/drive-ref-bootstrap-approval.json and fill every REPLACE_AFTER_HUMAN_APPROVAL from the 'Session digests' check name and the run's step summary of a bootstrap-plan run, then commit it yourself. The bootstrap write path refuses to apply while any placeholder remains (APPROVAL_NOT_FINALISED) and refuses outright if any value differs from the plan it just recomputed (REVIEWED_PLAN_NOT_MATCHED).
_why: A run that compares itself to its own plan proves the write matched that plan; it cannot prove the write matches what a human reviewed in an earlier run. These values are that pin, and the digests are the only content allowed here - no drive ids, no filenames, no SQL.
